zh-CN.title: 桌面面板，更少打断
items: 桌面聊天与广场详情改用无蒙层浮动面板，可继续操作原页面
通讯与菜单详情改用左右分栏，多级内容在同一面板内切换；手机端保持原样

en.title: Desktop panels, fewer interruptions
items: Desktop chat and Square details now float without blocking the page underneath
Contacts and menu details open alongside their lists; nested pages reuse one panel. Mobile is unchanged
